svg.title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Capacity
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-core-and-two-expansion-seats; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Capacity; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled Small-Team: 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The first four entries are core seats with numeric values of 1, representing 1 FT + 3 C. The final two entries have numeric values of 0 because they are expansion seats excluded from core headcount; adding 1 FT + 1 C produces the six-person scaled pod of 2 FT + 4 C. FT means full-time and C means contractor, not a full-time-equivalent commitment. External vendor and trade sub-crews are charged to direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not internal pod headcount. Allocate each labor charge once; contractor hours and local loaded payroll must fit the modeled cost envelopes.; caption: The four-person core supports canonical $250,000 and $1,025,000 gross-revenue scenarios; the $1,800,000 scaled scenario uses six people. FYMC 2.0 score: 85/100; rank #20 of 29; tier: Elite Small-Team Cash Machine. Automation does not remove technical accountability.; stages: label: Core FT 1: Commercial and operations lead; value: One core full-time seat | Buying, sales, and inventory; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own demand qualification, acquisition ceilings, written sale terms, contribution estimates, and aged-stock decisions. Oversee receiving quarantine, cost allocation, and buyer acceptance scheduling; reconcile physical assets against the inventory ledger weekly. Keep commercial urgency separate from technical release.; label: Core C 1: Biomedical specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Testing and repair; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform model-qualified inspection, repair planning, calibration checks, functional testing, and signed technical findings. Escalate unavailable parts or unsupported software before the commercial lead commits acquisition funds. Specify qualified external bench work when needed and allocate unit-level labor to direct costs without duplicate overhead.; label: Core C 2: Logistics and decontamination coordinator; value: One core contractor seat | Biological controls and delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate qualified external decontamination providers, device-compatible procedures, process records, and occupational exposure controls. Arrange packing, insured freight, receiving appointments, site readiness, and damage claims. External cleaning, packing, and installation crews are direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not additional pod seats.; label: Core C 3: Data and documentation specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Media and traceability; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map storage locations, perform authorized sanitization and verification, preserve permitted service evidence, and assemble release packets. Maintain serial-level inventory records and service-history indexing. Escalate device-specific regulatory questions for qualified review rather than inventing certifications.; label: Scaled FT 2: Account and inventory planner; value: Expansion only | One additional FT seat; zero core count; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Join only at scaled capacity to own recurring buyer accounts, replenishment forecasts, site readiness follow-up, and aging reviews at the $1,800,000 gross-revenue scenario. Add capacity against measured workload and funded payroll, not a revenue aspiration alone; this seat raises full-time headcount to two.; label: Scaled C 4: Additional field biomed specialist; value: Expansion only | One additional C seat; zero core count; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Join only at scaled capacity to provide additional qualified bench or installation coverage when test queues and geography exceed the core specialist's capacity. Maintain the same instrument calibration, evidence standards, and serial-level accountability; this seat raises contractor headcount to four.

text.title: Four Core Seats, Six at Scaled Capacity

rect.title: label: Core FT 1: Commercial and operations lead; value: One core full-time seat | Buying, sales, and inventory; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own demand qualification, acquisition ceilings, written sale terms, contribution estimates, and aged-stock decisions. Oversee receiving quarantine, cost allocation, and buyer acceptance scheduling; reconcile physical assets against the inventory ledger weekly. Keep commercial urgency separate from technical release.

text.title: Core FT 1: Commercial and operations lead
text.tspan: Core FT 1: Commercial and operations lead

text.title: Own demand qualification, acquisition ceilings, written sale terms, contribution estimates, and aged-stock decisions. Oversee receiving quarantine, cost allocation, and buyer acceptance scheduling; reconcile physical assets against the inventory ledger weekly. Keep commercial urgency separate from technical release.

rect.title: label: Core C 1: Biomedical specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Testing and repair; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform model-qualified inspection, repair planning, calibration checks, functional testing, and signed technical findings. Escalate unavailable parts or unsupported software before the commercial lead commits acquisition funds. Specify qualified external bench work when needed and allocate unit-level labor to direct costs without duplicate overhead.

text.title: Perform model-qualified inspection, repair planning, calibration checks, functional testing, and signed technical findings. Escalate unavailable parts or unsupported software before the commercial lead commits acquisition funds. Specify qualified external bench work when needed and allocate unit-level labor to direct costs without duplicate overhead.

rect.title: label: Core C 2: Logistics and decontamination coordinator; value: One core contractor seat | Biological controls and delivery; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Coordinate qualified external decontamination providers, device-compatible procedures, process records, and occupational exposure controls. Arrange packing, insured freight, receiving appointments, site readiness, and damage claims. External cleaning, packing, and installation crews are direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not additional pod seats.

text.title: Core C 2: Logistics and decontamination coordinator

Coordinate qualified external decontamination providers, device-compatible procedures, process records, and occupational exposure controls. Arrange packing, insured freight, receiving appointments, site readiness, and damage claims. External cleaning, packing, and installation crews are direct subcontractor/COGS pass-through, not additional pod seats.

rect.title: label: Core C 3: Data and documentation specialist; value: One core contractor seat | Media and traceability; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map storage locations, perform authorized sanitization and verification, preserve permitted service evidence, and assemble release packets. Maintain serial-level inventory records and service-history indexing. Escalate device-specific regulatory questions for qualified review rather than inventing certifications.

text.title: Core C 3: Data and documentation specialist

Map storage locations, perform authorized sanitization and verification, preserve permitted service evidence, and assemble release packets. Maintain serial-level inventory records and service-history indexing. Escalate device-specific regulatory questions for qualified review rather than inventing certifications.

rect.title: label: Scaled FT 2: Account and inventory planner; value: Expansion only | One additional FT seat; zero core count; numeric value: 0.0; detail: Join only at scaled capacity to own recurring buyer accounts, replenishment forecasts, site readiness follow-up, and aging reviews at the $1,800,000 gross-revenue scenario. Add capacity against measured workload and funded payroll, not a revenue aspiration alone; this seat raises full-time headcount to two.
